leaf_access_schedule: CALL writes the four-byte return offset to the actual native stack under ordinary Win32 flat stack assumptions, then transfers to __getptd. Provider body and side effects are outside this packet.
Only after a normal provider return with expected stack restoration: MOV ECX,DWORD [ESP+4] reads all 32 argument bits. No argument payload load precedes the provider call.
MOV DWORD [EAX+0x14],ECX writes exactly four bytes. There is no local null check, bounds guard, value mask, previous-field read, repeat store or arithmetic transformation.
RET consumes the actual stack return offset, with no immediate stack-argument cleanup. EAX is unchanged after the call; ECX holds the loaded DWORD. Logical return type remains unestablished.

register_and_storage_scope.own_registers: EAX provider output used as address; ECX receives incoming DWORD; ESP participates in CALL/argument addressing/RET. No incoming ECX/EAX value is consumed before the provider.
register_and_storage_scope.own_flags: No flags-dependent branch or leaf flags modification outside provider; provider flags effects unresolved.
register_and_storage_scope.own_segments: No explicit segment override; ESP uses normal SS and EAX address normal DS. Ordinary Win32 flat-segment/32-bit-stack domain only; no arbitrary segment descriptor identity.
register_and_storage_scope.own_other: No local x87, SSE, string/REP, DF-sensitive instruction, global/TLS cell, allocation, bitmap, local stack buffer, jump table or separate runtime helper. Named provider may have such dependencies; not closed here.
